zh.title: 中華航空更新輕旅行會員計畫，新增碳抵換點數回饋機制
zh.summary: 中華航空更新輕旅行會員計畫，新增碳抵換點數回饋機制
body: 中華航空股份有限公司表示，輕旅行會員計畫新增點數回饋機制。會員完成「環保旅程（Eco Travel）」碳抵換後，可獲得輕旅行點數；搭配其他挑戰項目累積達8點，即可享有購票優惠。
中華航空表示，環保旅程是與英國專業機構 Climate Impact Partners 合推的旅客自願碳抵換服務，旅客可依個人需求抵換旅程產生的碳排放。會員搭乘中華航空股份有限公司或華信航空股份有限公司自營國際航班時，完成網路預辦登機、減輕託運行李重量，或線上預選商務艙、豪華經濟艙餐點等指定綠色行動，也可累積點數。

en.title: China Airlines adds points for Eco Travel offsets in updated program
en.summary: China Airlines adds points for members completing Eco Travel carbon offsets under its updated program.
body: China Airlines said its Easy Travel membership program has added a points-reward mechanism. Members can earn Easy Travel points after completing a carbon offset through Eco Travel. When points accumulated with other challenge activities reach eight, members can receive ticket-purchase offers.

China Airlines described Eco Travel as a voluntary passenger carbon-offset service developed with UK-based Climate Impact Partners. Travelers can offset emissions generated by a trip according to their individual needs. Members can also earn points for specified green actions on China Airlines- or Mandarin Airlines-operated international flights, including online check-in, reducing checked baggage weight, and selecting meals online in business or premium economy class.
